name: Infinite Spell Game
description: Physical magic, spell crafting and firing, finite stored mana, a readable battlefield, and two visual treatments.

invariants.accounting: Sensing, rules, executed logic and effects consume their declared energy costs. Sleeping execution is not charged as active work.
invariants.magic: Mana is physical energy: harnessed, stored and released. A cast has a finite funded budget.
invariants.presentation: Pixel world and anime-style cel shading are both requested. Voxel world is excluded; world rules and rendering style remain separate.
invariants.supply: No unlimited automatically recharging mana. Capacity and replenishment mechanics are not fixed by this baseline.

traits.compatibility.verification: Unverified; pinned inputs identify what must be checked together.
traits.source.history: Historical dark/brooding moon landscapes and MarkovJunior are relevant inheritance; no-sun lore and intelligent materials are not selected here.

avoid: Treating the existing AI storyboard as approved game design
notes: Design decision is separate from task completion, asset selection and implementation evidence. Reference images are on the off-path design-review board; no selected image anchor is asserted.
